newsitem.title: USA: SoftNet names chairman, chief executive.
newsitem.headline: SoftNet names chairman, chief executive.

text.p: SoftNet Systems Inc said Wednesday its board of directors named Ronald Simon as chairman and Johann Oosthuizen as chief executive.
Simon has been a board member since 1995. He is vice president and chief financial officer of Western Water Co and president of Ronald I. Simon Inc, a financial consulting firm.
Oosthuizen is also president and chief operating officer of SoftNet, and will continue in those positions.

John McDonough previously served as chairman and chief executive of SoftNet. He resigned to pursue other business commitments and fund raising activities for the Juvenile Diabetes Foundation International.
SoftNet provides electronic information and document management systems.
